pages.text: The red box is the overclocking switch. Overclocking effects:$(br)$(a)+parallel count$(br)$(c)-percentage reduction to total parallel count$(br)$(c)+energy consumption$(br)The blue box is the cooling system switch. Cooling system effects:$(br)$(a)-removes the negative effects of overclocking$(br)$(a)+overflowing parallel count will reduce working time

The blue port inputs coolant, and the red port outputs waste fluid. The specific parameters of available coolants are as follows:$(br)1mB Water → 1mB Steam -15 heat$(br)1mB Crushed Ice → 1mB Water -30 heat$(br)1mB IC2 Coolant → 1mB IC2 Hot Coolant -90 heat$(br)1mB Liquid Helium → 320mB Helium -170 heat$(br)1mB Liquid Nitrogen → 320mB Nitrogen -190 heat$(br)1mB Frigid Cryotheum → -240 heat
